name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries VR-10 'Plow'
description:
A reinforced kinetic ram system integrated into a heavy vehicle's front end, consisting of a 400-kilogram tungsten-composite blade mounted on hydraulic shock absorbers that allow the vehicle to impact barriers, other vehicles, and fortified positions at speed without disabling the vehicle itself. The VR-10 transforms a standard armored truck into a battering ram that can breach concrete barriers, flip passenger vehicles, and smash through reinforced gates at speeds up to 80 km/h.

Zheng-Dao manufactures the Plow for military convoy operations where the lead vehicle must be capable of clearing roadblocks, barricades, and ambush positions without stopping. The hydraulic shock absorption system distributes impact forces across the vehicle's reinforced frame, preventing the chassis damage that would normally disable a vehicle after a high-speed collision. A Plow-equipped vehicle can impact a concrete jersey barrier at 60 km/h, shatter it, and continue driving without significant speed loss.

The VR-10's most controversial deployment is in forced-entry operations against occupied structures. A Plow-equipped vehicle driven through a building's ground-floor wall creates an entry point that no door breach or explosive charge can match — a vehicle-sized hole with a vehicle still in it, providing mobile cover for the entry team riding inside. The building's occupants are simultaneously dealing with a collapsed wall, a vehicle in their living room, and armed personnel deploying from it. The psychological impact is overwhelming.
legality: Military — restricted to authorized vehicle modifications
specifications:
ram weight: 400 kg
material: Tungsten-composite blade
impact rating: Concrete jersey barrier at 60 km/h
shock absorption: Hydraulic, 4-stage progressive
vehicle integration: Heavy truck or APC chassis
installation weight penalty: 600 kg total system
tactical_use: Barrier clearance, vehicle interdiction, and forced structural entry. The Plow converts a heavy vehicle into a breaching tool that creates entry points impossible to achieve through conventional methods. Used primarily in convoy operations and forced-entry raids.
cultural_context: The Plow represents the most literal form of corporate power projection in GLMZ — the ability to drive through walls. Residents of the Shelf who have witnessed Plow-equipped vehicles breach residential buildings describe the experience as feeling like the entire world is being rearranged by force. The weapon doesn't target people. It targets the structures that people depend on for safety.
known_users: Corporate raid units requiring forced structural access
story_hooks: A Plow-equipped vehicle was driven through the front of a Shelf community center during a neighborhood meeting, collapsing the building's facade and injuring thirty people. The vehicle was abandoned at the scene. No entry team followed. It wasn't a raid — it was a message.

Someone has stolen a Plow-equipped armored truck from a Zheng-Dao depot. The vehicle weighs 12 tonnes and can drive through buildings. It hasn't been found, and every structure in GLMZ with ground-floor walls is now a potential target.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist wedge of industrial purpose—a massive tungsten-composite blade angled forward like a medieval prow, mounted flush against a reinforced vehicle's front end. The blade's leading edge is needle-sharp where it meets the bumper assembly, then thickens dramatically toward the hydraulic integration points. The overall impression is predatory momentum made solid.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall blade width: 240 cm (vehicle-specific mounting). Blade depth: 85 cm front-to-back. Height above bumper: 110 cm. Tungsten-composite cutting edge: 3.5 cm thick tapering to 1.2 cm point
physical_description.weight_description: Feels like concentrated gravity—400 kg of blade mass plus 200 kg of hydraulic/structural integration creates a felt impression of inexorable force. The vehicle's suspension noticeably compresses under the weight; movement is deliberate and massive.
physical_description.primary_material: Tungsten-composite blade (70% tungsten, 30% hardened steel matrix). Hydraulic cylinder bodies: chrome-plated steel. Shock absorption struts: reinforced aluminum frame with elastomer dampening sleeves.
physical_description.finish: Blade: deep gunmetal gray with micro-etched surface for reduced ricochet (industrial non-reflective). Hydraulic components: worn brushed steel with oil residue hazing. Impact scarring visible across blade face—concrete dust burnishing on the leading edge.
physical_description.color_scheme: Tungsten-gray blade (slightly darker toward leading edge due to impact oxidation). Hydraulic assemblies in industrial steel silver. Accent striping in Zheng-Dao corporate red (5cm bands at mounting points).
physical_description.grip_texture: N/A — vehicle-integrated weapon. Control interface: reinforced pressure-switch mounted on driver's console (textured rubber button with tactile feedback), approximately 4cm diameter.
distinctive_features: Progressive-stage hydraulic cylinders (4 visible units, each 25cm bore, staggered along blade base for load distribution)
Concrete dust impact rings—visible scoring patterns where previous barriers have been breached
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries serial plate (15cm x 8cm, mounted on right-side hydraulic housing) with stamped maintenance log cutouts
Leading edge micro-serrations (6mm teeth pattern) for structural engagement rather than slipping
Oil-stained underframe where hydraulic return lines route to vehicle's main system
Reinforced bumper brackets showing weld-point stress marks from impact cycling
Pressure gauge cluster (3x analog gauges, 7cm diameter each) mounted on accessible hydraulic manifold
Wear pattern: central blade strike zone shows marble-white concrete residue in micro-crevices
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries full corporate logotype (15cm wide) red-inlaid into steel mounting plate on right-side hydraulic assembly. Serial number etched into blade root: 'ZD-VR10-[XXXXXX]'. Installation certification plate (stainless steel, 8x12cm) bolted to underside hydraulic manifold with current maintenance date and authorized technician cipher.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn and still operational. Blade retains manufacturing micro-finish on protected surfaces but shows heavy concrete scarring, steel-gray showing through where impacts have stripped micro-etching. Hydraulic components clean but oil-residue-stained. No rust (tungsten-composite resists corrosion) but visible stress whitening around weld points. Pressure gauges show consistent use history.
